item.title: Vue Computed Property Context Issue with Arrow Functions Fixes
item.description:
“Vue Computed Property Context Issue with Arrow Functions Fixes”

Encountering issues where this does not refer to the Vue instance within computed properties, methods, or watchers? This frequently happens when developers use ES6 arrow functions in component definitions. Arrow functions inherently bind this to their surrounding lexical scope, which, in the context of a Vue component instance definition, is not the instance itself. How can we reliably access component data and methods?
